full_judgment: 3. The plaintiff then moved the High Court Division and obtained Rule in Civil Revision No. 7212 of 1991 and after hearing the High Court Division discharged the Rule holding that the Sale Deed No. 5666 dated 13.12.1956 which was executed by Zager Hossain son of late Nuruzzaman, of Syedbari, thana Rangunia, in favour of one Moktar Hossain, the defendant No.1, shows transfer of an area 26 1/2 decimals of land to the defendant No.1 and thus giving him ejmali possession in R.S. Plot No. 749 under the R.S. khatian No. 829 but the trial court disbelieved the above sale deed only on the ground that according to the plaint the name of the plaintiff is "Zakir Hossain" but in the Sale Deed No. 5666 the name of the executant is shown as "Zager Hossain" but unfortunately the trial court did not at all consider the facts that the particulars of the transferor and transferee both in the above Sale Deed No. 5666 and the plaint are same and all the averments of the plaint are consistent to the statements made in the above Sale Deed No. 5666 except the spelling of the name of the executant of the above Sale Deed No. 5666 and thus arrived at an erroneous finding; the trial court could have found the name "Zager Hossain" son of Nuruzzaman from the solenama dated 12.1.1953 Ext.3, and the trial court also could have found the name of Zager Hossain, son of late Nuruzzaman, out of the same address and as such the spelling, by variation of two letters, has not affected the genuineness and merit of the Sale Deed No. 5666 or the rights of the parties and the lower appellate court has rightly set aside the judgment and decree of the trial court. The High Court Division further held that in the solenama dated 12.1.1953 Ext. 3, on the basis of which the plaintiff claimed his title, the name of the plaintiff has been shown as "Zager Hossain" and so writing the name of the plaintiff as "Zakir Hossain" in the plaint made no difference and further the Sale Deed No. 5666 was executed on 13.12.1956 and the suit was instituted in the year 1982 and the absence of any finding about the oldness of the above Sale Deed No. 5666 has also adversely affected the findings of the trial court in the given facts and circumstances of the case.
